name: Abelson helper integration site 1

function.text: AHI1 is the approved symbol for Abelson helper integration site 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in cell surface receptor protein tyrosine kinase signaling pathway; cilium assembly.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include Joubert syndrome 3 (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Papillary renal cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; Definitive GenCC assertion, ClinGen. Allele-specific review required.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: AHI1 encodes Abelson helper integration site 1. Its functions include cell surface receptor protein tyrosine kinase signaling pathway and cilium assembly.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include Joubert syndrome 3 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AHI1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.
